title: Large Language Models as Fiduciaries: A Case Study Toward Robustly Communicating With Artificial Intelligence Through Legal Standards
reasoning: The paper explores using legal standards, specifically fiduciary duty, as a framework for AI alignment with human intentions and values. It evaluates LLMs on their ability to understand these standards, which are inherently normative and involve ethical obligations of care and loyalty. The work explicitly references moral judgment, ethical frameworks, and value alignment.
